verdict.rationale: Blaxel's core product is isolated cloud sandboxes for code execution that agents can create and operate via skill, MCP, or SDK. Several documented features support safe testing away from production. Fork and snapshot let agents test on copies and roll back. Per-domain allow/deny lists restrict outbound traffic and prevent data exfiltration. Non-root scoping limits what sandboxed code can do. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolation guarantees separating sandboxes from production data/resources, a distinct test-vs-production environment mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
